stage: V41: physical support, published action contract, and continuation-value mechanism audit
frozen_before: Any V41 real-state Monte Carlo or full physical replay; toy mathematical tests, archival receipt audit and synthetic publication-channel tests are preparatory only.
fixed: All 148 original public states and 72 physical roots on the same six development dates; all original menus, physical fit parameters, emission fit and SingleMessage selector; no data/OD/outcome filters or retuning. Conservative GTFS station MCT stays unchanged.
model_change: V41_exact_integer_anchor_finite_chain_v1 explicitly refines finite support for actual off-grid hard observations. Each fixed basis conditions exact own events and local absence; scorer and sampler consume the same law. Within a sampled world future on-basis observations never refine support. Prior parameters and original model/receipts remain untouched. Message reselection is the original working update rule, not a proved global future-message likelihood.

continuations.legacy: V40 FastPlanner plus SingleMessageHistory and AnchoredWorld; model-only control and reproduction anchor
continuations.physical: New PhysicalHistory/Planner and checking-only sampled world; original first-offer tail and actual combined waiting
continuations.shallow: New physical law; one-transfer min(first-offer,single-target commitment) envelope with original deeper child marks; actual combined waiting. Explicit inexpensive approximation, not exact full G_pi. Complete physical continuations separately estimate G_pi.

reference_budget: 148 states x 5 arms = 740 fixed 128-world paired evaluations: legacy, physical, shallow, physical_meeting, shallow_meeting. Every pair uses both ALIGHT and CONTINUE. Check legacy per-world fields against old receipts and meeting/nonmeeting results against each other. In every state also evaluate frozen-child-marks repeated-Combined policy exactly at the current alighting platform (all candidates, no fitted subset).
online_budget: Exactly 10 configurations x 72 roots = 720 fresh complete controls. All actual trajectories and new histories remain. Six original nonzero roots and every new gain/harm retained. No conditional future archive frames and no reuse of saved action values online.
sampling: Fixed sample sizes 16 or 128, no CPU stopping. Generate original 128 uniforms per sorted physical trip, same original full paths. 16 uses its first 16 worlds and pays for all 128 generated. Original semantic public-state match reuses original seed irrespective of controller action; otherwise seed=int(SeedSequence([41050,root_index,current_cid]).generate_state(1)[0]). New physical model may change sampled clocks, which is measured rather than called old-model parity.
ordinary_meeting: Per paired world only: reuse a completed continuation at identical ride/platform entry, full remaining node, entry/ready/after clock, entire ordered hard history, all raw forecasts, notices, message state and physical-basis identity. Both arms have same world and fixed base policy. No current-action key used as permanent meeting certificate. Whole traces, outcomes and decision counts must match full execution. This is a standard control, not new method.
cost: Single process, one BLAS thread, rotated arm order. Manifest and common archive/graph prepared once and resident for every method, charged separately. Per-control cold model/history/planner, history processing, sampling, all tail compilation, all continuations, meeting keys and publication channel processing charged. Per-decision intervals plus final execution partition total. Condition/sample stages and planner counters separate; embedded phase costs never added again to totals. No favorable timing reruns.
publication: Real asynchronous publisher verified separately on declared model windows with consumer-visible fallback and received-time deadline checks; retain timely/late/zero-window outcomes and all worker cost. Natural archive lacks public door-open/close windows. Main paired travel experiment retains the ideal public-event contract, uses the common publisher at that logical time, and makes no hard real-time or physical latency claim.
statistics: Missing outcomes remain in full 148/72 denominators with [0,deadline-clock] empirical bounds. Single-complete-pair SE and CI are unavailable, not zero. Fixed-size MC uncertainty is separate from empirical missing bounds and actual development-cohort gains.
decision: First assess physical internal closure, then how much the stronger shallow control and exact frozen-Combined reference explain, then remaining full-policy evaluation cost. Standard meeting/caching alone cannot reopen the closed algorithm route. A future-message branch is conditional on a supported model of timely future publications and a concrete new structural claim; no full information-tree campaign or new-date confirmation is authorized by finding a favorable development example alone. Either propose one constructive, literature-distinct result with evidence or close this stage without relabeling existing principles as novelty.
